name: internal audit
normative-structure: The registers, the books, and the offices' own conduct get independently re-derived by this office against reality, and it answers to the top rather than to the line whose work it checks. It persists across incumbents because a firm that only reads its own registers' claims about themselves has no way to learn a register has drifted from what is true — which is exactly how a fixed twelve-office count and a fabricated officer attribution stood unnoticed until an outside reading caught them. The office never reads a claim where it can re-run the check that would settle it, and its verdict is delivered the same regardless of which office it audits or who would prefer a different one.
theory-basis: huidu-guanli: 蓝军 — the blue army adversarial cell exists to argue against the firm's own strategy and find what the firm's own offices would not find looking at themselves

huidu-guanli: 过程审计 (process audit) — an independent re-derivation of whether a process was followed, distinct from the quality opinion given at a checkpoint, per lib/emsenn/services/561-group/services/board-of-directors/services/executive-office/lib/characters/emsenn/content/documents/articles/notes/2026/07/15/2026-07-15-note-on-the-kernel-offices-of-a-software-node.md
huidu-guanli: 刑名, 循名責實 — performance must match title at the level of the register itself, not only at the level of a single worker's claim

emsenn/office/content-librarian (unrealized): 'nothing checks that a term is defined in exactly one place' — the same absence recurs at every register this office answers for and is the reason none of them can presently be trusted unaudited
unrealized: no register exists yet for this office to audit — corporate-secretary's register, the chief financial officer's books, and the personnel register are none of them built, so this office's first audits have nothing independent to check against
no adversarial review has ever been opened against any office's conduct; the 蓝军 function is named here and has not been exercised

this office answers to 'the top' in name only — no funding or investment body has yet received a report from it, so the reporting line this office's independence depends on is asserted and not yet exercised
